summary: All 6 phases complete. git-commit-phase.sh now deposits each containment-dropped files_touched path into the task's own .return-meta.json proposed_file_scope at drop time (flock-guarded, additive, idempotent, fail-open), and the existing --file-scope-add consumer chain (update-task-status.sh, skill-base.sh's skill_postflight_update) was widened from {research, plan} to {research, plan, implement} to forward it on the implement-postflight path, auto-merging with no confirmation gate per the research/plan's own ruling. All five dispatch VERIFY fixtures plus idempotence and deposit-path fail-open are pinned by new/retargeted test cases across three suites (181 passing assertions), the drop-and-warn excursion guard and every fail-open posture are byte-for-byte unchanged, and an end-to-end throwaway-fixture check confirmed the full drop-propose-merge-no-re-drop loop closes. The deployed tree was redeployed twice (the second to pick up a shellcheck fix in this task's own new test code) and is fresh for core/lean/nvim.
